normal_gradient_flow.native: tokens B4S2048 -> vocab-offset normalization -> sort 8192 token IDs plus iota -> gather cotangent by matching sort permutation; while.108 tuple[10] BF16[B4,S2048,D2048] -> BF16 scatter into [Vlocal32768,D2048] -> BF16 all-reduce({0,2},{1,3}) -> feature dynamic-slice D1024 -> optimizer BF16-to-FP32 conversion.
normal_gradient_flow.legacy: tokens B4S2048 -> negative normalization -> collective-permute 1<->2 -> batch all-gather B8 -> vocab-offset adjustment -> sort 16384 token IDs plus iota -> gather matching cotangent by sort permutation; while.60 tuple[1] BF16[B4,S2048,D2048] -> copy/bitcast [B4,S2048,2,D1024] -> BF16 all-to-all(axis_0,dimension2) -> bitcast [16384,D1024] -> BF16 scatter into [Vlocal32768,D1024] -> optimizer BF16-to-FP32 conversion.
normal_gradient_flow.interpretation: Both begin embedding transpose from batch-sharded/full-feature BF16 cotangents. Native first accumulates each batch shard into full-feature rows and sums those partial BF16 rows across the data axis before retaining its feature shard. Legacy exchanges cotangent feature chunks and gathers matching token indices so each shard accumulates all batch tokens for its feature shard before any FP32 conversion. Same final placement does not constrain this intermediate grouping.
normal_gradient_flow.cast_boundary: No BF16-to-FP32 cast occurs between the identified while output and completed BF16 embedding gradient in either normal executable; legacy all-to-all and native scatter/all-reduce retain BF16. Incoming full-layer cotangents are not established equal by this audit.
normal_gradient_flow.final_storage: Both normal optimizer inputs are BF16[32768,1024] per-device, then FP32[32768,1024]. Both canonical reported gradients are FP32 global [65536,2048], spec [model,data], same ordered TPU device list; axis types Auto vs Explicit are deliberate.

evidence_boundaries: Optimized HLO establishes typed operations, call/operand ordering and collective groups, not hardware instruction accumulator precision, scatter execution order, atomic implementation, or a source-level/full-kernel root cause.

Reported canonical gradient errors come from a separate hook-enabled diagnostic executable; retained HLO belongs to the no-hook train step. Matching first-step execution-state/diagnostic reports strengthen relevance but do not prove identical diagnostic scatter lowering.
Raw arrays were not retained. Incoming BF16 cotangent equality, mismatch coordinates, repeated-token multiplicities, and causal contribution of accumulation grouping cannot be independently checked.

Small upstream differences can feed embeddings, including the surviving block-0 o_proj discrepancy. A public embedding VJP control must use identical cotangent values, not native and legacy separately produced upstream gradients.
No claim about unchanged baseline 36e lowering is made here; only latest candidate 8aa artifacts are traced.
bounded_next_control_design: First pin source-derived layout: storage P(model,data), native compute P(model,None), tokens P(data,None), residual/cotangent P(data,None,None); legacy parameter/compute mappings and native sharding definitions are cited below. Then use one same-topology four-device v5p control with the frozen versions/XLA flags, global V65536 D2048 B8 S2048 and original storage P(model,data). Invoke public legacy Embedding.embed and native public JAX weight.at[tokens].get with the same residual output placement, preserving their Auto/Explicit axis modes. Differentiate with respect to FP32 weights through the production BF16 compute cast/reshard boundary.

Construct the FP32 embedding weights, int32 token IDs and exactly BF16 common cotangent once. Reuse identical global bytes for both VJPs and assert dtype/shape/values and canonical physical placement before comparing gradients. Use a frozen benchmark-token fixture if reconstructible, plus at most one explicit repeated-token/cancellation fixture; do not claim either reconstructs the absent full-Trainer cotangent.

Compare canonical FP32 embedding gradients under the unchanged BF16 atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4, retaining max/mean abs, relative L2, mismatch count and selected coordinates. Include a common FP32-accumulation reference for the same tokens/cotangent to localize summation error without changing acceptance thresholds.

Retain both minimal public VJP optimized HLOs and verify whether the observed scatter/redistribution order recurs. If minimal graphs lower differently, record non-reproduction; add no speculative embedding fix. A passing control only bounds this isolated operation and does not clear full-Trainer parity or authorize a speed ratio.
